summary: Randomized sound/HUD trigger variant. Reads a pointer from this+0 and twice calls RatioComputationWithClamping on the sub-object 12 bytes into it to obtain clamped ratio values. Two sequential noise samples are pulled from the weather-noise table flt_8AB274 using the advancing byte counter dword_8AAE70. An LCG random value picks one of three HUD base indices (17 for rand < 10922, 16 for 10922 <= rand < 21844, 15 otherwise), and HUDElementConfig(this, base, 1, v11, v10) writes the two computed intensities to the HUD element. Called on the frame path by PositionLapStateUpdate (00447E00) and RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate (004EF930).

local_names.v5: second raw noise sample from the table
local_names.v7: LCG random value selecting the base index

operations.description: First call to RatioComputationWithClamping with the pointer read from this+0 advanced by 12 bytes, yielding a clamped ratio v2
Noise sample v3 = flt_8AB274[(unsigned byte of dword_8AAE70)++] * 0.050000001; intensity v11 = v3 + v2 * 0.85000002 + 0.15000001
Second call to RatioComputationWithClamping on the same 12-byte-advanced sub-object, yielding a clamped ratio v4
Second noise sample v5 = flt_8AB274[(unsigned byte of dword_8AAE70)++] and LCG value v7 = RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator
Index selection: if v7 >= 10922 then v8 = (v7 < 21844) + 15 (yielding 16 or 15), else v8 = 17
HUDElementConfig(this, v8, 1, v11, v10) writes both computed intensities to the indexed HUD element and its result is returned
Invoked on the frame path by PositionLapStateUpdate (00447E00) and RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate (004EF930)
